blocks.name: Core Schema & Type System
blocks.rationale: Defines the architecture model data types, parsing/serialization, validation, slicing, diffing, merging, and all core analytical operations on models.

blocks.name: Manifest & AST Scanning
blocks.rationale: Performs AST-based source code scanning to produce reality manifests including module info, function signatures, call graphs, body hints, and test contract extraction.

blocks.name: Configuration & Discovery
blocks.rationale: Handles project configuration loading, auto-discovery of source roots and functional blocks, and the configuration schema definition.

blocks.name: CLI
blocks.rationale: Provides the command-line interface entry points for init, validate, slice, diff, enrich, decompose, and other user-facing commands.

blocks.name: Orchestration & Enrichment
blocks.rationale: Orchestrates the multi-stage pipeline (scan → model → enrich → decompose), auto-enrichment from manifests, behavior flow classification, and LLM context formatting.

blocks.name: Domain Profiles
blocks.rationale: Implements the domain profile system enabling cross-domain modeling (software, controls, mechanical, electrical) with schema extensions and conditional validation rules.

blocks.name: Export & Documentation
blocks.rationale: Generates documentation artifacts (component specs, ICDs, health reports, dependency matrices) and flat-file exports from architecture models.

blocks.name: Utilities & Infrastructure
blocks.rationale: Shared utilities for file discovery, exclusion patterns, metrics collection, persistence/snapshots, pattern catalogs, and the JSON Schema spec.

blocks.name: Benchmark & Test Scripts
blocks.rationale: End-to-end benchmark scripts for extraction, round-trip regeneration, multi-repo evaluation, and model enrichment utilities.

matched_pairs.note: Both contain all 18 core/*.py files. Perfect match.

Both contain exactly config/__init__.py, loader.py, schema.py.
Both contain cli/ files plus package root files (__init__, __main__).

disagreements.llm_rationale: LLM-E includes integrations/llm_context.py with orchestration because enrichment and LLM context formatting are tightly coupled in the pipeline (enrich.py imports llm_context patterns). The tool keeps orchestration/ strict to package boundary (8 files) while LLM-E adds 1 cross-package file (llm_context.py). The tool has only 3 orchestration files in its manifest (missing pipeline.py, auto_enrich.py, deep_decompose.py, behavior_flows.py, enrichment_context.py, naming_context.py from its scan).
disagreements.cites_doc: CONTEXT.md: 'Orchestrates the multi-stage pipeline (scan → model → enrich → decompose)'

disagreements.llm_rationale: Tool has F4=Extract as single file (extract/from_code.py). LLM-H groups extract/from_code.py with utils/, monitoring, patterns, persistence, spec, and data — all small infrastructure modules. This is a cross-cutting utility grouping that the tool splits into F4, F8, F9 plus orphans. The LLM grouping reflects functional cohesion (shared infrastructure) while the tool reflects directory structure.
disagreements.cites_doc: Package Structure in CONTEXT.md shows utils, spec, extract as separate packages

disagreements.llm_rationale: Tool's F8 (Spec, 1 file) is absorbed into LLM-H's infrastructure grouping. spec/__init__.py is a JSON Schema holder with no real logic — grouping it standalone is over-segmentation.
disagreements.cites_doc: CONTEXT.md: 'Spec — too small for separate systems, modeled in top-level'

disagreements.llm_rationale: Tool's F9 (Utils, 2 files) is absorbed into LLM-H. Same reasoning as F8 — too small for standalone block.
disagreements.cites_doc: CONTEXT.md: 'Utils — too small for separate systems, modeled in top-level'

disagreements.llm_rationale: LLM-G (Export & Documentation) covers docs/ (10 files) and export/ (3 files) which have NO tool F-block assignment at all — they are missing from the tool's manifest entirely. These 13 files are orphaned by the tool's scan. The LLM groups them together because both generate output artifacts from models.
disagreements.cites_doc: Files exist on disk but absent from .architecture-models/manifest.json modules list

disagreements.llm_rationale: LLM-I (Benchmark Scripts) covers scripts/*.py which are outside src/ and not part of the tool's package scan scope. The tool correctly excludes them; the LLM includes them as a functional subsystem for completeness.
disagreements.cites_doc: scripts/ directory exists with 16 benchmark/utility scripts
